So no available compute — algebraic OR Bring-coordinate — lands 0.588; it remains the open color-fibre (z₀) geometric W_λ.

The magnitude stays owner-gated to the GEOMETRIC W_λ realization (WRT(S³/2I)), for which this is now a sharp, second binding-side falsifiable target alongside the m_τ tower: any index reproducing W_λ must land f_pn in (0.395, 0.661) and at 0.58776.
